item.title: How to Read the Crypto Fear and Greed Index
item.description: Learn how to read the crypto Fear and Greed Index, what its zones from extreme fear to extreme greed mean and how to combine sentiment with Bitcoin price, open interest, funding and ETF flows.

item.title: Hyperliquid HIP-4 Explained: How Outcome Markets Could Change Onchain Trading
item.description: Hyperliquid HIP-4 brings outcome markets to onchain trading. Learn how HIP-4 works, how outcome contracts differ from perps and what could come next.

item.title: What Are Funding Rates in Crypto? A Complete Beginner's Guide
item.description: Learn what crypto funding rates mean, how positive and negative rates work, how funding fees are calculated and what they reveal about market sentiment.

item.title: What Is Open Interest in Crypto? A Complete Beginner's Guide (2026)
item.description: Learn what open interest in crypto means, how it works, why traders monitor it and how it helps identify market trends. A beginner friendly guide with real world examples.

item.title: Bitcoin ETF Inflows Extend Winning Streak as BlackRock's IBIT Leads Institutional Demand
item.description: Bitcoin ETF inflows continued as BlackRock's IBIT remained the largest driver of institutional demand. Here is what Bitcoin ETF today data, ETF holdings and recent outflows mean for investors.

item.title: How to Spot Bitcoin Trend Reversals Before Everyone Else: 9 On-Chain and Market Signals That Actually Matter
item.description: Learn how to identify Bitcoin trend reversals using nine proven on chain and market indicators including funding rates, open interest, liquidation data, whale activity, market sentiment and more.

item.title: What Are Stablecoins? A Complete Beginner's Guide to Crypto's Most Stable Digital Assets
item.description: Learn what stablecoins are, how they work, the different types of stablecoins, their benefits, risks and why digital dollars like USDT and USDC have become essential to the global crypto economy.

item.title: Why Bitcoin Turned Bullish After Funding Improved
item.description: Bitcoin's short term outlook shifted as perpetual funding moved back to positive and open interest firmed. Here is what changed in the derivatives market and what it means for the next 24 hours.
